description: Profile x JD scenarios for the resume-quality eval. expected_fit is judged from each JD's stated minimum experience (verified official postings, paraphrased) versus the profile's professional (non-internship) experience and domain. 'under' = below the stated level, 'mismatch' = below level and/or off-domain, 'match' = meets it. Where a posting states no minimum (Amazon SDE 2968029), level fit is judged as entry-level.

scenarios.why: Entry-level SDE; the verified posting states no minimum years. A's evidence is projects only, so domain depth (distributed/real-time systems) is thin, but the level fits.
SWE II asks for 1 year of software development in Python, C, C++, Java or JavaScript; A has none.
Deliberate seniority mismatch: SDE II asks for 3+ years; A is a fresher.
Entry-level SDE with no stated minimum years; internship plus DSA fits the level.
Internship only against a 1-year experience minimum.
3.2 years of professional backend development meets 3+ years.
Exceeds the 1-year minimum; strong Java/distributed-services overlap.
Off-domain: 2 years of embedded QA (not software development) plus a current career break, applying to a general SDE role emphasising distributed and real-time systems.
Off-domain (embedded QA) for a Cloud software engineering role.
About 3.3 years of full-stack development plus 1 year of QA; must lead with the development evidence.
Exceeds the minimum; broad skills must be narrowed to the relevant ones, not stuffed.
